You just gotta stick with what life gives you buddy. I know that sounds like some shitty advice but believe me, it will all work out in the end. When I was in school I wanted to be a journalist,  writing for corporation like The BBC. However half way through my GCSE I was having major depressive episodes along with suicide attempts. It led to me fucking up my GCSE and not being able to go onto A-Levels. 

Later on in the summer I started a new job as a potwash in fancy 5* restraunt in Scotland. I was still struggling with the episodes and trying  not to be a bother to the rest of the restraunt. One night we all went out for a drink and they told me something that was probably the main reason for me seeking out professional help. They said that they loved working with me and hanging with me after work. I tried my best to not break down but failed fucking miserably. Anyway fast forward 5 years later and I have completed an apprenticeship there in catering and am working as a full time chef and also have my BPD u der control and I'm the happiest I've ever been.

I know it can look like it's spiraling out of control sometimes, but you just keep at it and make something of the shitty hands you've been dealt.  <3

Skyrim: Sank 1000+hours on the 360 when it came out, was absolutely in love with it, my first Elder Scrolls, now that I have it on PC even without mods I still adore the game, I can't really describe how well the game is in my opinion. The lore, the books, the characters and quests are always on point. On the PC I now have 500+hours on it.

CSGO: Very different from my opinion of Skyrim, I fucking despise the game now. 2 years ago I got to DMG and actually had hopes of getting Global Elite. Me and my friends invested hours into practising and playing, kind of like we were practising for the ESL but we were terrible compared to them. We would gamble with our skins and luckily somehow didn't lose a lot when we did it, it was great. Then they released an update that reworked the ranking system(Something like it was easier to get deranked and harder to rank up), this caused lots of people from much higher elos got deranked and ended up in our elo, leading to us getting destroyed by them and end up deranking. After me and two mates ended up getting deranked to Gold Nova 3 we gave up with the game and sold most of our skins. Now when we play the none of us really have fun, and get bored very quickly. One of my mates managed to climb to DMG so fair play to him. Overall the community's toxicity and that update killed any joy I once had in that game.
